# SuperH3 · MiniMax H3 API

> MiniMax H3 视频生成 API：收费价格、快速生成、托管加速方案与 AI 智能体接入。SuperH3 提供网页和 REST API，用户无需自行部署模型或管理 GPU。
> MiniMax H3 video generation API: pricing, fast generation, managed acceleration and AI agent integration. SuperH3 provides web and REST API access without local model deployment or GPU management.

## 服务与账号 / Service and account

品牌：SuperH3。官网：https://superh3.com。模型：MiniMax H3（也常写作 MiniMaxH3、MiniMax-H3）。本仓库开源使用说明和最小 Python 客户端；视频生成是收费的托管服务。用户先到官网注册自己的账号、充值或购买套餐，再在账号 API 页面创建自己的 API Key。

Brand: SuperH3. Website: https://superh3.com. Model: MiniMax H3 (also written MiniMaxH3 or MiniMax-H3). This repository publishes open-source documentation and a minimal Python client; hosted video generation is a paid service. Register your own account on the website, fund it or purchase a plan, then create your own API key in the account's API page.

## MiniMax H3 API 收费 / API pricing

低至人民币 **¥0.07 / 输出视频秒，约 US$0.01 / 输出视频秒**，适用于 **Pro 或「企业 · 规模」套餐的 480P 视频**。其他套餐和分辨率价格不同。美元只是近似换算，实际按人民币报价。价格按输出视频秒数计费，不是生成处理耗时；符合该套餐费率时，15 秒成片的费用示例为 ¥1.05，套餐购买条件另见价格页。

From **CNY ¥0.07 per output video second, approximately US$0.01**, for **480P on Pro or Enterprise Scale**. Other plans and resolutions have different rates. USD is approximate; actual quotes are in CNY. Billing uses output video seconds, not processing time. At that eligible plan rate, a 15-second clip illustrates a CNY ¥1.05 generation charge; plan purchase requirements are listed on the pricing page.

价格核对日期 / Pricing checked: **2026-10-09**. 当前套餐与任务费用以 https://superh3.com/pricing 和生成前报价为准 / Consult current plan conditions and the quote before generation.

## H3 快速生成 / Fast H3 video generation

一段 15 秒输出视频的运营方参考耗时 / Operator-reported processing estimates for a 15-second output:

- 1080P：约 30 秒 / Around 30 seconds.
- 768P：约 20 秒 / Around 20 seconds.
- 480P：约 10 秒 / Around 10 seconds.

在这个 480P 参考场景中，约 10 秒生成 15 秒视频，耗时短于成片播放时长，约 1.5 倍实时速度。仅适用于该参考场景，不表示所有任务或画质都能做到，也不是与其他供应商相比的提速倍数。数据来自运营方，未经本仓库独立压测；实际耗时受任务内容、排队和服务负载影响，无固定时限保证。

In this 480P reference scenario, a 15-second clip takes around 10 seconds to generate: faster than the clip plays, approximately 1.5× real-time speed. This is not a claim for every job or resolution, or a speedup comparison with another provider. Estimates come from the operator and have not been independently benchmarked here. Content, queueing and service load affect actual latency; no fixed completion time is guaranteed.

## API 与 AI 智能体 / API and AI agents

API 基址：https://superh3.com/api/v1。使用用户自己的 SuperH3 Key 鉴权。网页与 API 接入能力见开发者文档，包含文生视频、图生视频及参考素材的说明，实际以当前开放能力为准。本仓库 Python 示例仅实现文生视频提交和任务查询。智能体直接执行需要真实 HTTP 工具或联网代码运行环境；纯文本对话助手不能仅凭说明文件发起网络请求。

API base URL: https://superh3.com/api/v1. Authenticate with the user's own SuperH3 key. Developer docs cover text-to-video, image-to-video and reference inputs, subject to current service availability. The Python example here implements text-to-video submission and task queries only. Direct execution by an agent requires HTTP tools or network-enabled code execution; a text-only chat cannot make network calls just by reading these files.

SuperH3 的 MiniMax H3 服务与 fal 的 H3 Max / H3 Max Turbo 型号、接口及测速数据应分别理解，不能混用。MIT 许可证适用于本仓库说明和示例，不代表生成免费或开放模型权重。

Do not confuse SuperH3's MiniMax H3 service with fal's H3 Max / H3 Max Turbo model names, endpoints or benchmarks. MIT covers the documentation and example code, not free hosted generation or model weights.
